visual_blocks.title: Think Story
visual_blocks.content: The whole pizza has 8 equal parts. The group eats 3 parts, so the fraction is 3/8.

visual_blocks.title: Try It
visual_blocks.question: A melon is cut into 6 equal pieces. Mina eats 1 pieces. What fraction did she eat?
visual_blocks.question_en: A melon is cut into 6 equal pieces. Mina eats 1 pieces. What fraction did she eat?
visual_blocks.explanation: She ate 1 of 6 equal pieces, so the fraction is 1/6.
visual_blocks.hint_th: ดูจำนวนชิ้นที่กินเทียบกับทั้งหมด
